extraFacts.fact: SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2 specify 37° flared tube fittings, commonly called JIC fittings: the male has a 37° cone and the female swivel nut draws it onto a matching 37° seat, so the seal is metal to metal and the thread only holds the joint together.

extraFacts.fact: SAE J512 45° flare fittings use a 45° cone seat and are not interchangeable with 37° JIC fittings, even where some thread sizes match; a 37° male will not seal in a 45° female or the reverse.
extraFacts.source: SAE J512 (automotive tube fittings, 45° flare) compared with SAE J514

extraFacts.fact: NPT is a tapered 60° pipe thread (ASME B1.20.1) that seals by thread interference with sealant; NPTF is the dryseal version (ASME B1.20.3). SAE straight-thread O-ring boss (ORB) ports to SAE J1926 / ISO 11926-1 seal on an O-ring, not on the thread.
